title: dMRI Rosetta Stone: a controlled comparison of diffusion tensor estimators across FSL, MRtrix3 and DIPY
description:
A container that runs FSL, MRtrix3 and DIPY on byte-identical diffusion MRI data, together with the scripts that compare their tensor fits on two open datasets (Stanford HARDI and Sherbrooke 3-shell), on Rician-noise phantoms with known eigenvalues, and in simulations built on the real gradient tables.

Every table in the accompanying article is regenerated by the scripts in this archive; the commands are listed in its Supplementary Material. The container also serves an interactive interface presenting each pipeline stage in the three toolkits side by side.

Licensed MIT. Note that the bundled FSL carries its own licence restricting commercial use.
